acceptance_gates.requirement: Authoritative source identity, inventory, mirrors, and exclusions reproduce exactly.
All 120 required translation units parse; one miss is a blocking failure.
Canonical compile argv and environment replay with exact set and byte equality.
All required roots arise from typed declarations, definitions, or assignments.
Identifier, filename, historical, global, and synthetic fallback counts are zero.
Every graph edge has exact source support and the required evidence fields.
Argument-to-parameter and return-to-caller flows are implemented and tested on corpus code.
Member and cache writes connect to reads across functions without spelling inference.
Unresolved aliases and virtual targets either resolve or block completeness.
All sixteen BeamSetup PDF pointer roles have local typed installation/accounting paths.
PDF-object alpha_s providers and routing paths are represented or block closure.
Hard-process NC, ISR/backward-evolution, and remnant paths are represented.
The 672-member holdout has zero binding UNRESOLVED and NOT_RECOVERED entries.
All generic-name and co-located-occurrence controls pass.
Independent neutral-name/interprocedural recall challenge finds no material miss.
Two independent graph generations serialize byte-identically.
An independent reviewer reproduces source, commands, graph, and calibration.
Runtime-only properties remain explicitly unresolved and never satisfy a static gate.

authoritative_source_contract.generated_configuration_note: Upstream configure materializes Makefile.inc, not a required core parse header; a future task must fail if an include is missing.

optional_feature_configuration.policy: Expand and re-review the corpus before claiming a path that depends on a disabled module.

canonicalization: Store argv arrays, never shell command strings.
Normalize paths to repository-relative POSIX paths and stable root placeholders.
Sort entries by semantic_file_id and reject duplicate or omitted translation units.
Exclude output paths, wall-clock values, host paths, and non-allowlisted environment.
Hash canonical compact JSON for the command set and environment separately.
compilation_database_contract.optional_modules: All external plugins disabled; core 120 translation units required.

cost_bound.estimate_scope: One pinned toolchain, the 247-file/120-TU core corpus, fail-closed graph relations, calibration, controls, and static evidence only.

failure_scope: Failure would reject this bounded Clang-18.1.8 static consumer-graph plan; it would not prove all future source-analysis methods impossible.

negative_controls.required_proof: The exact lexical occurrence must lie on a typed, source-backed provenance path.

next_step.condition: Only a later explicit decision may open a separately scoped static-evidence implementation task.

non_failure_scope: Feasibility does not establish graph completeness, signed-rate mathematics, runtime reachability, generator compatibility, or permission to implement.

objective.scientific_objective_unchanged: p(theta_PDF | D), where D is a set of events
objective.task: Decide whether a separately reviewed AST-grounded PYTHIA PDF-consumer graph task is technically bounded and scientifically useful.

scientific_decisiveness.not_merely_lexical_reason: LibTooling can anchor typed declarations, calls, assignments, parameters, returns, and fields; repository logic must connect only source-supported relations and fail closed.
stop_conditions: Any required translation unit cannot be parsed reproducibly.
Interprocedural or member flow cannot be source-backed within the implementation cap.
The holdout or independent challenge exposes a material missed path that cannot be bounded.
The result degenerates into identifier, filename, global, historical, or synthetic fallback.

selected_toolchain.reason: The pinned API exposes typed AST and source locations while permitting repository-owned fail-closed interprocedural normalization within the cost cap.

runtime_only_properties.later_evidence: Separately authorized configuration-specific runtime pointer identity trace.
Separately authorized post-init mutation trace over the selected configuration.
Reviewed configuration plus runtime target observation for every dynamic dispatch site.
Separately authorized bounded query-envelope measurement with support checks.
Separately authorized concurrency and lifecycle validation.

acquisition_and_pinning_strategy.method: Future task obtains official llvm-project tag llvmorg-18.1.8 and verifies peeled commit before a separate reviewed installation/build step.

alias_pointer_analysis.future_requirement: Resolve only source-supported points-to/assignment facts; serialize every remainder as blocking.
alias_pointer_analysis.limitation: General C++ alias closure and runtime pointer replacement are not guaranteed.
alias_pointer_analysis.primary_evidence: Typed pointer/reference assignments can be extracted from the AST.

cxx_language_and_templates.future_requirement: Fail closed on a required template use without a materialized specialization.
cxx_language_and_templates.limitation: Only materialized instantiations in the fixed translation-unit set are visible.
cxx_language_and_templates.primary_evidence: Clang 18.1.8 parses C++11 templates and exposes typed AST declarations and instantiations.

deterministic_serialization.future_requirement: Sort canonical source-backed keys and hash normalized records.
deterministic_serialization.limitation: Raw traversal order and compiler-internal IDs are not a stable artifact contract.
deterministic_serialization.primary_evidence: USR/type/coordinate anchors can be normalized independently of traversal order.

dynamic_dispatch.future_requirement: Emit candidate targets and block closure when the target set is not closed.
dynamic_dispatch.limitation: Runtime-selected concrete targets cannot be proven statically.
dynamic_dispatch.primary_evidence: Typed virtual call sites and class hierarchies are representable.

field_member_dataflow.future_requirement: Index field identity and all writes/reads across the authoritative corpus.
field_member_dataflow.limitation: Cross-function write/read flow requires repository-owned indexing.
field_member_dataflow.primary_evidence: Member expressions and field declarations carry static type and coordinates.

interprocedural_call_and_return.future_requirement: Implement deterministic call-site/parameter/return matching and fail on unresolved callees.
interprocedural_call_and_return.limitation: Clang AST traversal alone does not construct whole-program value flow.
interprocedural_call_and_return.primary_evidence: AST call expressions, function declarations, parameters, and returns expose the required anchors.

macro_handling.future_requirement: Serialize both spelling and expansion ranges or emit MACRO_GENERATED_USE_UNRESOLVED.
macro_handling.limitation: Macro-generated semantics need an explicit expansion policy.
macro_handling.primary_evidence: Clang source locations distinguish spelling and expansion coordinates.

source_coordinate_stability.future_requirement: Bind every coordinate to source SHA-256 and canonical compile-command identity.
source_coordinate_stability.limitation: Coordinates change if source bytes or flags change.
source_coordinate_stability.primary_evidence: Pinned bytes plus Clang spelling/expansion offsets provide deterministic coordinates.

toolchain_candidates.compilation_database_requirements: A deterministic repository-owned JSON Compilation Database containing all 120 release translation units and exact Clang argv arrays.
